description: A highly optimized appearance preset cycler. It allows you to organize your appearance presets into subfolders within 'Saves/Person/Appearance' (e.g., Male, Female). Each folder automatically becomes a separate Lookset collection. Select a target character and seamlessly cycle through looks or switch collections using clean UI buttons or customizable screen-overlay hotkeys without opening menus.
credits: Special thanks to MeshedVR for Virt-A-Mate and Acidbubbles for the VSCode plugin template.
instructions:
1. Put your appearance presets (.json) into subfolders inside 'Saves/Person/Appearance' (each subfolder will act as an individual Lookset).
2. Add CircleLooks as a Session Plugin.
3. Select a Target Person in the UI.
4. Use customizable screen-overlay hotkeys (Default: L for Next Look, K for Prev Look) to cycle presets seamlessly while the UI window is closed.
